title: WRAM map for the Secret of Mana dual-screen companion
conventions: Addresses are offsets in the 128 KiB WRAM image ($7E:xxxx = xxxx, $7F:xxxx = 0x10000 + xxxx). Verification: verified = changed by a mutation and read back (or an exact observable match); partial = single data point or documentation only; unverified = documented elsewhere but not exercised; not-obtained = no ROM could be run.

vanilla_us.state: route frame 23000 (Potos village, map 131) of tools/fidelity_d_inputs/hhs_glitch_bk2_s9x14.txt + fixture

magno_es.state: same route desyncs; frame 20000 of the route is in map 128 with a controllable hero (HUD not yet enabled) + fixture

ancient_cave.status: ROM generated, not bootable past the name entry in the headless harness; no runtime verification
ancient_cave.source: Moppu/SecretOfManaRandomizer v1.49 (LGPL-2.1), Windows .NET app that writes a 4 MiB ROM from the user ROM; no IPS/BPS patch exists
ancient_cave.static_diff: 159 regions differ from the vanilla image in the first 2 MiB; bank C0 has 54 hook sites (JSL $E0xxxx replacing code) including ring/menu routines

fields.name: hero_record_base
fields.meaning: Three hero records, stride 0x200; offsets below are relative to the record
fields.evidence: docs/rom-combat.md 1.1; tools/companion/som_companion.c; slots 1 and 2 verified separately by activating them with event opcode 0x2B and by casting as each

fields.name: hero_active
fields.meaning: 1 = member present and active; 0 = absent; 0x80 seen after event opcode 0x2C removal
fields.evidence: src/rom/cycle_to_next_eligible_unbound_menu_actor.s tests byte == 1; runtime: slots 1/2 0 -> 1 after event 0x2B (test_01 reads [1,1,1] after the fixture, [1,0,0] before)

fields.name: hero_object_id
fields.meaning: 0x80 boy, 0x81 girl, 0x82 sprite
fields.evidence: docs/rom-combat.md 1.1 (E1E7); dump of the three records

fields.name: hero_level
fields.meaning: Internal level, display = value + 1
fields.evidence: docs/rom-combat.md; status page shows LEVEL 1 for 0 (screenshot, vanilla only)

fields.name: hero_hp
fields.meaning: Current HP (word)
fields.evidence: Mutation: pending damage 7 (+0x1F1) took HP 50 -> 43; Candy macro healed 20 -> >20; Royal Jam macro 20 -> 50; poison status ticked HP down 1 per timer drop

fields.name: hero_hp_max
fields.meaning: Maximum HP (word)
fields.evidence: HUD shows HP/max matching the word (50/50, 45/45, 40/40) for the three heroes

fields.name: hero_mp
fields.meaning: Current MP
fields.evidence: Cast macro: girl MP 8 -> 4 (Gnome first spell); sprite MP drop; pending MP damage 2 (+0x1F5) 8 -> 6

fields.name: hero_mp_max
fields.meaning: Maximum MP
fields.evidence: Spell ring title shows "MP08/08" for MP 8 / max 8
fields.note: read-only check against the spell ring caption

fields.name: hero_status
fields.meaning: Status word. Bit 15 (+0x191 bit 7) = dead/not initialised: such a hero is skipped by the owner cycle and the HUD shows HP 0. Bit 13 (0x2000) = 1 HP per timer drop while +0x1B6 counts down
fields.evidence: Mutation: writing 0x2000 + timer 20 reduced HP 2 per 40 frames and the timer 0x14 -> 0x05; clearing bit 15 made the girl selectable with X
fields.note: other status bits: docs/rom-combat.md section 7, not re-verified

fields.name: hero_status_timers
fields.meaning: Status timers, one byte per status family; +0x1B6 is the one for bit 0x2000
fields.evidence: Poison mutation above (only +0x1B6 exercised)

fields.name: weapon_recharge
fields.meaning: Weapon recharge counter: 0 = ready, jumps to about 0x55 on a swing and counts down. HUD percent = 100 - value*100/85
fields.evidence: HUD crops at four times show 60/73/82/91 % for 0x22/0x17/0x0F/0x07

fields.name: weapon_charge_level
fields.meaning: Power-up charge stage of the swing (documented); not reproduced
fields.evidence: Holding B for 240 frames with weapon level 8 and CFB0 = 8 never charged in the synthetic state: values stayed 0

fields.name: weapon_type
fields.meaning: Equipped weapon type 0..7 (sword 1, axe 2, spear 3, javelin 7 observed in the ring)
fields.evidence: Equip macro: type 1 -> 2 for the axe

fields.name: weapon_row
fields.meaning: Weapon table row = type*9 + tier (sword tier 0 = 9, axe tier 2 = 20)
fields.evidence: Equip macro: 9 -> 20

fields.name: weapon_slots
fields.meaning: Owned weapon per type: 0xFF = not owned; low bits = tier (0..8); bit 6 (0x40) set on the type the boy has equipped
fields.evidence: Equip macro: sword 0x40 -> 0x00 and axe 0x02 -> 0x42; ring lists exactly the non-0xFF types in type order
fields.note: bits for girl/sprite equips not decoded

fields.name: weapon_levels
fields.meaning: Eight 4-bit weapon levels (even type = high nibble)
fields.evidence: docs/rom-combat.md section 1.1 [V] by earlier harness; not re-mutated here

fields.name: spirit_levels
fields.meaning: Eight 4-bit spirit levels, byte order = spirit mask byte order
fields.evidence: Spell level read back after casts equals the nibble written for bytes 0..5 (E371 = 1..6); byte 7 read 7 not 8 (cap or encoding unexplained)

fields.name: spirit_masks
fields.meaning: Per spirit availability bits: a non-zero byte lists the spirit in the magic ring (0x3F gives 3 spells). Byte 6 is never listed for the girl, byte 7 never for the sprite; the boy has no magic ring. Ring order is byte order: Gnome, Undine, Salamando, Sylphid, Luna, Dryad, [Lumina], Shade
fields.evidence: Mutation grid: single-byte masks for both heroes; ring titles read off screenshots; casts for every listed spirit
fields.note: which bit is which spell is not decoded; 3F lists three spells

fields.name: spell_last_cast
fields.meaning: Spell id and level of the last cast (rom-combat 1.1); spell id = 6*ring_index + 3 + spell slot for the girl
fields.evidence: Observed 0x03/0x04/0x05, 0x09.., 0x15, 0x1B.., 0x22/0x23, 0x27 for ring entries 0..6

fields.name: items
fields.meaning: 12 consumable records in insertion order, 0xFF = empty, else (qty << 5) | item id; ids 0 Candy, 1 Chocolate, 2 Royal Jam, 3 Faerie Walnut, 4 Medical Herb, 5 Cup of Wishes, 6 Magic Rope, 7 Flammie Drum, 8 Moogle Belt, 9 Midge Mallet, 10 Barrel
fields.evidence: docs/items-shops.md; ring shows "Candy X3" for 0x60; use macro lowered 0x60 -> 0x40; ring order = record order (names read off screenshots)

fields.name: armor_slots
fields.meaning: Armor rows (low 6 bits) in three groups of 12; not needed by the companion
fields.evidence: Seen in dumps only

fields.name: gold
fields.meaning: 24-bit gold
fields.evidence: Status page shows 100GP for 0x000064

fields.name: hero_names
fields.meaning: Name glyph codes, 12 bytes per hero
fields.evidence: docs/scale-name-glyph-next-20261014.md; glyph table not decoded here

fields.name: ring_open
fields.meaning: 1 while the ring menu, the status page, the spell sub-ring or the target selection is open
fields.evidence: Toggles with Y; stays 1 during item target selection; 0 after use

fields.name: ring_owner
fields.meaning: Hero slot whose ring is shown; X cycles to the next living hero not bound to a pad
fields.evidence: src/rom/cycle_to_next_eligible_unbound_menu_actor.s; X changed it 0 -> 1 -> 2 -> 1

fields.name: ring_category
fields.meaning: 0 item, 1 magic, 2 config, 3 weapon; UP steps weapon -> item -> magic -> config -> weapon, magic is skipped when its list is empty; 0x55 when no ring has been built yet
fields.evidence: Observed for boy and girl rings; src step_native_menu_ring_category...

fields.name: ring_cursor
fields.meaning: Index of the selected entry; LEFT adds 1 mod count, RIGHT subtracts 1; updates about 9 frames after the press
fields.evidence: Tap timeline; every macro uses it

fields.name: ring_count
fields.meaning: Number of entries in the visible ring (spirit ring 7, spell ring 3, item ring = non-empty records, weapon ring = owned types, config ring 7)
fields.evidence: All rings; sub-ring switches 7 -> 3

fields.name: ring_busy
fields.meaning: Non-zero while the ring opens (frames 8..43 after Y); the game ignores navigation input while it is non-zero
fields.evidence: Frame timeline

fields.name: ring_menu_enable
fields.meaning: Story flag: pad-driven ring menus enabled (1)
fields.evidence: Fixture needed it on the Magno early state to let Y open the ring

fields.name: event_state
fields.meaning: Non-zero while the event VM runs (dialogue, cutscene, map-change script); 0 in free play, ring and status page
fields.evidence: Values 0x81, 0x85, 0x01 in cutscenes; 0 in field/ring; warp script sets 1

fields.name: fade
fields.meaning: Fade state: E4 = 1 and E6 = 0x0F when fully visible; E6 counts down during a fade out
fields.evidence: Warp timeline E6 0F..02 with E4 = 4

fields.name: map_id
fields.meaning: Current map id (131 Potos village, 128 falls, 256 opening room, 257 shop house, 179 prologue)
fields.evidence: Compared with docs/maps.md at six route frames

fields.name: pad_binding
fields.meaning: Bit n = hero n is bound to pad 1 (DA pad 2, DB pad 3)
fields.evidence: Read only; 1 in all single-pad states

modes.predicate: NO_GAME if hero0 active != 1; TRANSITION if E6 != 0x0F or E4 != 1; EVENT if D0 != 0; RING if 7D == 1; else FIELD
modes.safe_to_inject: mode == FIELD and a hero is bound to pad 1 ($D9) and that hero is alive

observed.situation: ring open / status page / spell target selection
cast animation after the ring closes
observed.note: no flag marks it; the macro verifies by MP drop within 330 frames

observed.hero0_active: 0 early; 1 with D0 != 0 during name entry in the vanilla route

ring_navigation.open: tap Y (3 frames); $7D becomes 1 within 2 frames, $1812 is non-zero for frames 8..43, ready at about frame 43
ring_navigation.owner: tap X until $1808 == hero; each step re-builds the ring, wait about 80 frames
ring_navigation.category: tap UP until $1809 == wanted (weapon 3, item 0, magic 1); wait about 40 frames per step; at most 4 taps in the cycle weapon, item, magic, config
ring_navigation.cursor: tap LEFT (+1) or RIGHT (-1) along the shorter way; $180A follows after about 9 frames; allow 22 frames per tap

confirm.weapon: 1 x B closes the ring and equips
confirm.item: B selects, a second B (target = bound hero) uses it; ring closes
confirm.magic: B on the spirit opens the 3-entry spell ring; cursor to the spell; B selects it; B on the target; ring closes; MP is paid after about 120..150 more frames

ring_navigation.needs: the unusable cases time out: an item the game rejects (Cup of Wishes on a healthy hero) keeps the target selection open and an attack spell with no enemy in range does not leave the ring; the macro gives up and closes the ring with A/Y taps

hud.vanilla: HUD occupies rows 199..216 of the 256x224 frame (hero boxes with HP numbers, gauge and portraits). Text, frames and the gauge are BG3 (snes9x layer 3); the portraits are sprites in the same rows. Dialogue windows and the ring title window are BG3 too; ring icons are sprites (layer 5). BG1/BG2 are the map, BG4 unused.
hud.hide_strategy: crop rows >= 199 from the video frame (core independent, used by the host). Layer toggles (snes9x_layer_3 / _5 core options) are all-or-nothing per layer and would also hide dialogue windows or every actor.
hud.not_found: OAM index ranges of the HUD sprites, TM/TS shadow registers and a HUD-visible flag were not identified; libretro exposes no OAM/PPU registers

ancient_cave.ring_related_changes: C0:6559 (ring poll), C0:657E, C0:692F (menu loop request), C0:6D1E (ring phase), C0:7AC3 (inventory), C0:7C8C (price)
ancient_cave.conclusion: The mode rewrites ring, inventory and start-of-game code; WRAM field compatibility is unproven until a generated ROM is booted. Run tools/companion/test_companion.py with SOM_TEST_ROM pointing at a booted state of the generated ROM.
